messages:
Ari (Marketing): Quick heads up: blog + benchmark goes live T+45. Need 1-sentence exec quote, press kit link, and triage channel. @Marta @Hana @Kai please.
Marta (Comms): Drafting quote now. Prefer something short and non-technical. Also will DM a small reporter list before social.
Leo (Product): Appendix updated with test methodology. Link: internal only. Confirm: no customer data used.
Hana (Legal): Confirmed. Must include 'No customer data was used.' Also use official product casing: 'Redwood Optimize'.
Ari (Marketing): Press kit uploading; ETA 10m. Avoid posting raw benchmark configs in public social.
press-monitor-bot: Monitoring enabled. Will report pickups >2k into #press-clips.
Marta (Comms): Exec quote option: "Redwood Optimize reduces inference cost for engineering teams while preserving latency." Thoughts?
Ari (Marketing): Good. Shorten to: "Redwood Optimize reduces inference cost while preserving latency."
Hana (Legal): Approve wording. Add footer: see appendix for methodology.
Marta (Comms): Final quote locked. DM outreach to 6 priority reporters in NA at T+5m, EU batch at T+25m, APAC later.
Kai (Support): Triage channel ready: #optimize-press-triage. I added an FAQ and escalation steps to eng-runtime.
Ari (Marketing): deploy-bot, schedule publish T+45.
deploy-bot: Publish job queued: blog-optimize -> scheduled in 45m.
Marta (Comms): Holding social until my "green". Will post status updates here after publish.
press-monitor-bot: TechWeekly replied asking for a short on-record quote and a contact engineer. Marta to coordinate.
Marta (Comms): I'll offer the exec quote and an engineer for a 15-min call. Pasting outreach copy in DMs.
Ari (Marketing): Keep replies short in this thread so we can do a quick readout after first hour. Thanks.
